print('verdict:', fm['verdict'])
print('hyp ids:', [h['id'] for h in fm['hypotheses']])
print('evidence ids:', [e['id'] for e in fm['evidence']])

for h in fm['hypotheses']:
    refs.update(h['evidence_for'])

for lf in fm.get('latent_findings', []):
    refs.update(lf['evidence'])
ev_ids = set(e['id'] for e in fm['evidence'])
print('unresolved refs:', refs - ev_ids)

started = fm['investigation']['started']
concluded = fm['investigation']['concluded']
print('started/concluded:', started, concluded)
